Stenosis privacy policy

Stenosis is a private speech recognition keyboard and service for Android that transcribes on your device by default.

Stenosis requires access to your microphone to work.

Stenosis uses your microphone to try to transcribe speech to text. Transcripts may be inaccurate, and can be quite wrong in some circumstances. Please ensure they are accurate before using them.

Unless you turn on server transcription (described below), Stenosis will not send the raw microphone data (not the transcripts, just the audio recorded from the microphone) anywhere; it will stay on your device and will only be kept long enough to transcribe it to text and assist with that task.

Server transcription is optional and off by default. It only takes effect if you turn it on for keyboard and/or conversation transcription in settings and enter a server URL. While it is on, for the mode(s) you turned it on for, Stenosis sends each recorded speech segment as an audio file to the server you configured, and only to that server, over an encrypted (https) connection, together with the optional model name and API token you entered, and receives the transcript back. Pressing "Test connection" in settings sends one second of silence to that server. Stenosis does not run or provide any such server; whoever operates the server you configure can receive that audio and is responsible for how it is handled, so only use a server you trust. Voice activity detection, noise suppression and speaker diarization still run on your device. Turn server transcription off to keep all audio on your device.

Transcripts may be sent to other apps if other apps use Stenosis to transcribe audio (if Stenosis is invoked from other apps without Stenosis visibly launching on top of the app, those apps will require the microphone permission to use Stenosis to transcribe audio from the microphone in real-time) or when using the Stenosis Voice Input keyboard (expanded on below), but otherwise will not be sent anywhere else and will stay on your device for as long as they are needed to help with the current transcript and any features that involve processing of the current transcript.

When using the Stenosis Voice Input keyboard, audio from the microphone will be transcribed and pasted into the currently selected text box. This means the app the text box is in will see the transcripts Stenosis pastes into the app's text box, similar to using a keyboard to manually type out what you want to say.

Please follow applicable local laws about recording, and transcribe responsibly.
 
Stenosis has links to websites which are not under our control. We are not responsible for the content of linked sites. If you have any questions about policies of linked sites, please refer to them.

Stenosis's privacy policy may be updated from time to time. When it does, you will be prompted to accept the new privacy policy upon opening the app.
